env.service: UNMAPPED_SERVICE_TEST=1 bun run service -- --port 8799 --data $SCR/service-data --browser-origin http://localhost:5190 (a fresh empty dir)
env.page: bunx vite --config docs/e2e/milestone-rev6-p4-mobile-proof/vite.e2e.config.mts (the repo's browser config with no watcher and no HMR; http://localhost:5190, the dev CSP that allows loopback)
env.world: bun --tsconfig-override tsconfig.node.json scripts/seed-shared-world.ts make --service ws://127.0.0.1:8799 --out $SCR/seed (aether-land 1.3.0 packed, uploaded and announced) → __INVITE__; … invite --out $SCR/seed → __INVITE_B__
env.desktop: app B: AETHER_TEST_USER_DATA=$SCR/ud-b bunx electron-vite dev --remoteDebuggingPort 9347, a fresh userData whose inference.json names an unreachable loopback llama.cpp (http://127.0.0.1:8098/v1, no sidecar) so nothing can call a model
env.driver: CDP_PORT=9342 (phone) or 9347 (desktop B) bun scripts/cdp-drive.ts "$(sed 's|__INVITE_B__|<B link>|; s|__INVITE__|<phone link>|; s|__SHOTS__|<dir>|g; s|/__REPO__|<absolute repo path>|g' <run file>)" — '/@fs/<absolute path>' is the exact URL the page imports these modules by, so the probes read the page's own module instances (a '//' path would load fresh copies)
env.viewport: phone: 375 × 812, deviceScaleFactor 2, mobile with touch emulation (each phone run starts with {viewport})
env.input: phone: touch only (tap, tapText, drags held on the docked stick) and text typed into the focused field; evals only read (samplePlayer, the land/session stores, remoteRoster, IndexedDB, window.seed.world.read/badges). Desktop B: clicks, typed text, the N key, one select() of its name field.

actions.eval: (async () => { const s = await import('/@fs/__REPO__/src/renderer/state/index.ts'); const inst = s.useSessionStore.getState().activeInstance; const l = s.useLandStore.getState(); const c = document.querySelector('canvas'); return JSON.stringify({screen: s.useSessionStore.getState().screen, look: s.useEngineStore.getState().landLook, canvas: c && {label: c.getAttribute('aria-label'), w: c.width, h: c.height}, seed: inst && inst.instance.save.seed, cartridge: inst && inst.cartridge.manifest.cartridgeId + '@' + inst.cartridge.manifest.version, scene: s.useWorldStore.getState().scene.status === 'ready' ? s.useWorldStore.getState().scene.value.contract?.sceneId : null, landMode: l.mode, chunks: Object.keys(l.chunks), notes: l.notes.length, chunk: s.useEngineStore.getState().chunk}); })()

new Promise((resolve) => { const open = indexedDB.open('unmapped-browser'); open.onsuccess = () => { const db = open.result; const tx = db.transaction(['blobs', 'places', 'entries', 'outbox'], 'readonly'); const out = {}; const b = tx.objectStore('blobs').getAll(); b.onsuccess = () => { out.blobs = b.result.map((r) => [r.hash, r.bytes.byteLength ?? r.bytes.length]); }; const p = tx.objectStore('places').getAll(); p.onsuccess = () => { out.places = p.result.map((r) => ({sceneId: r.position.sceneId, x: +r.position.x.toFixed(3), z: +r.position.z.toFixed(3)})); }; const e = tx.objectStore('entries').count(); e.onsuccess = () => { out.entries = e.result; }; const o = tx.objectStore('outbox').getAll(); o.onsuccess = () => { out.outbox = o.result.map((r) => r.events.length); }; tx.oncomplete = () => resolve(JSON.stringify(out)); }; open.onerror = () => resolve('no db'); })

actions.eval: (async () => { const b = await window.seed.world.badges(); const id = b.value[0].worldId; const r = await window.seed.world.read(id); const now = r.value.snapshot.now; return JSON.stringify({head: now.head.n, pack: now.pack, me: r.value.status.me, link: r.value.status.link, pending: r.value.pending.map((p) => p.event.body.text ?? p.event.kind), notes: now.notes.map((n) => ({n: n.n, by: now.names[n.author] ?? n.author.slice(0, 9), author: n.author, text: n.body.text, coord: n.body.coord}))}); })()
